items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-21
items.q: The interviewee (Dominic J. La Rocca) does not mention Alice Kern in his testimony. Alice Kern is introduced by the interviewer as a notary public who provided a sworn affidavit regarding La Rocca's composition of 'Tiger Rag'. There is no evidence in the transcript that La Rocca personally knew, met

ctx.x: Susu Ramis played guitar Willie guitar played bass Harry Nunez played violin and I played the comic we played in the downtown section that is way down below Elysian Fields Avenue now this is 19 2 3 and 4 and 5 no night I made ahead I went ahead of my statement 19 3 4 and 5 and maybe 6 the uptown band I played with a boy named George Gieffer George Gieffer bass Joe Taranto guitar Freddie Inglot this boy sells ice cream around the streets today violin and Nick LaRocca this group this group and all the above groups…

came and appeared, Mrs. Alice, how do you pronounce her? Alice, Alice Kern. Alice Kern, K-I-E-R-N. A female person over the age of majority and full well known unto me notary public, who first being duly sworn, disposed and said as follows, that deponent was well acquainted with and has personally known for more than 25 years, one Dominic J.
